slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots produced per fighter jet allocated to training in each year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked for the per-jet annual training capacity, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarified the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the fighter jets allocated to training in year 1 produce trained pilots in both year 1 and year 2, or do they only produce pilots in the year they are first allocated to training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the training timeline/duration across year 1 and year 2, which covers the hidden start-and-duration fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot and P1 training-duration slot were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; only the P2 combat-jet mapping slot was left unasked.

summary: The agent resolved the key P0 and P1 modeling facts through focused questions, then stopped appropriately; it missed only the low-impact P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping detail.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
